meta.title: WoT Playground
meta.description: Explore public Nostr follows in an interactive social graph. Switch between graph, list and timeline views.

extension.requiredDesc: The Web of Trust browser extension is needed to explore your social graph and trust connections.
extension.clickToActivate: Click on the WoT extension icon in your browser toolbar to activate it, then click retry below.
extension.installDesc: Download and install the Web of Trust extension for your browser.
extension.helpText: After installing, refresh this page or click retry to connect.

hero.title: WoT Playground
hero.subtitle: Explore public Nostr follows and discover connections in 2D and 3D.

connectModal.title: Connect to Get Started
connectModal.description: Connect your Nostr identity to interact with the Web of Trust extension and explore your social graph.

login.title: Connect to Nostr
login.subtitle: Sign in with your Nostr identity to access the playground and test the Web of Trust API.
login.noExtensionHelp: Install a Nostr signer extension like Alby, nos2x, or Keys.band to continue.
login.nip07Notice: Uses NIP-07 to securely access your public key. Your private key never leaves your extension.

extension.title: Browser Extension
extension.help: Click below to connect using your installed Nostr signer extension.

key.title: Private or Public Key
key.inputHelp: Use nsec for full access or npub for read-only mode
key.securityNote: Your private key is stored in session storage and cleared when you close the tab. For better security, use an extension or bunker.

bunker.title: Remote Signer (Bunker)
bunker.scanHelp: Scan this QR code with your Nostr app to connect
bunker.compatibleApps: Compatible with nsec.app, Amber, and other NIP-46 signers
bunker.urlHelp: Paste your NIP-46 bunker connection URL

createAccount.title: Create Account
createAccount.description: New to Nostr? Get started with nstart.me

graph.distanceHint: Higher values show more distant connections
graph.notInNetwork: This user is not in your loaded network
graph.clickToExploreDesc: Click the root profile to load its follows
graph.emptyFollows: This public follow list is empty.
graph.nodeLimit: Showing {count} people. Collapse a branch to explore more.
graph.sourceHint: Public follow connections. Scores reflect follow distance and shared paths.
graph.localSourceHint: Public follows stored on this browser. Scores use the locally collected graph.
graph.extensionSourceHint: Graph and scores supplied by your extension.

entry.label: Nostr public key
entry.help: Connect your extension, or enter an npub/hex to build a graph on this browser.
entry.invalid: Enter a valid npub or 64-character hex public key. Secret keys are not accepted.
entry.emptyDescription: Start with a public key, then expand profiles to discover their follows and connections.
entry.extensionMissing: No Nostr extension found. Install or enable one, or enter a public key.
entry.extensionFailed: The connection failed or was declined. Try again or enter a public key.

saved.title: Saved graphs ({count})
saved.description: Graphs built here are stored on this browser. Extension databases are managed in the extension.
saved.confirmDelete: Delete {count} saved graph(s)? You can rebuild them from relays.
saved.unavailable: Storage is unavailable in this browser.
saved.counts: {nodes, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {edges, plural, one {# follow} other {# follows}}

sync.extensionHelp: Sync and manage this graph in the extension.

sourceErrors.storageUnavailable: Local graph storage is unavailable in this browser.
sourceErrors.noFollows: No follow list was received from the relays. Your saved graph has been kept; try syncing again.
sourceErrors.extensionEnable: Enable Web of Trust in your extension, select Local mode, and sync its graph first.
sourceErrors.extensionLocal: Select Local mode and sync the graph in your extension first.
sourceErrors.accountChanged: The extension account changed. Connect again to load its graph.

sourceErrors.invalidDepth: Invalid sync depth. Choose a depth from 1 to 3.
